scope: Python wrapper edits: ticks, shared color scales, series ownership, snapshot transactions, linked-axis traversal and grid placement
changes: Plot/overlay/colorbar ticks use one node translator; ordinary edits no longer construct a code-generation Figure.
Tick arguments are converted once per operation and mutable colors remain independent between axes.
Colorbar text layout runs before the one snapshot commit, without a nested batch and second edit.
Constructors, resident color bindings and artist/scale edits share complete-domain validation and label fitting; palette-only updates skip geometry fitting.
Panel ownership resolution is shared by Figure.update, colorbar lookup and marker/vector color binding; no snapshot-per-axis search.
One detached copy is retained at apply_settings boundaries; redundant reset/staging copies and duplicate reads are removed while isolation and nested rollback remain.
Linked groups use linear membership traversal; grid weight sums and panel lookup are computed once per placement.
Numeric argument validation no longer depends on the plotting-object module.
Colorbar grid options now raise before committing instead of silently discarding the request.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/test_wrapper_edit_paths.py tests/test_matplotlib_api.py tests/test_round3_api_regressions.py tests/test_public_appearance.py tests/test_renderer_018_features.py tests/test_compact_codegen.py tests/test_styles.py tests/test_style_inheritance.py tests/test_invalid_state.py tests/test_linked_axis_edits.py

benchmark.method: Same script and CPU notebook backend, nine warmed samples (three for linked groups); allocation peaks and operation counts measured separately. 25-panel edits and synthetic 100/1000-element layout/group inputs.
benchmark.limitations: Diagnostic wall-clock measurements, not FPS or physical-GPU performance. Concurrent local UI checks can affect timings. Linear membership lookup uses extra temporary memory, shown in the allocation peaks. No thresholds were relaxed.

regression_guards: Complete snapshots on failed edits and nested rollback
Direct expected tick lengths/colors and unchanged other panels
Same scale owner in subplots and overlays
One measurement of complete color domain; none on palette-only change
Snapshot read count independent of panel count
Linear member/weight/panel visits rather than timing thresholds
